name: is_stageA_repro
description: IS-PhaseForge Stage A: reproducibility freeze + instrumentation baseline (Professor §12A). Same-commit rerun of the Can baselines against the frozen bank (seed 2026, 50 cases) with full-trace scaffolding in place. Bank freezing is operator-side (invoke eval steps with eval.bank.auto_generate=false so a missing bank fails loudly instead of regenerating); it is not a per-cell override because train steps compose without the eval group. No architecture changes. Exit: 3-seed NMI/entropy/SR reproduce the debug baseline within Wilson overlap.
